name: Explosive Barrels

source.title: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace

disable: DC 20 Survival check to smother the flames without rupturing the barrels

items.name: Explode
items.text:
Trigger 4 rounds pass after the agents' arrival without anyone smothering them

---

Effect The barrels explode, dealing 3d6+8 fire damage to everything within a 20-foot radius (DC 20 basic Reflex save save).

text: Wooden barrels marked with an oil-drop symbol catch fire and explode.
